user_goal: Make the designated v0.1.7 release contract truthfully validatable and its evidence hashes platform-stable.

authority.verbatim_text: Correct verified release validation blockers before merging Plotkeeper v0.1.7.

baseline.protected_ref: exact reviewed candidate before validation remediation
baseline.protection_evidence: clean pushed PR head independently reviewed
baseline.selection_reason: Canonical reviewer found missing VALIDATED obligation and newline-sensitive evidence hashing.

semantic_changes: Add one truthful VALIDATED obligation and enforce LF for tracked goal contracts; rebind canonical hashes and pointer.
No product behavior, merge, release, install, service, secret, or user-data mutation.

invariants: All release acceptance requirements remain intact.
Working-tree and Git-blob contract evidence hashes agree across platforms.
No phase advances without canonical PASS.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Canonical review can truthfully validate and bind the designated release contract on Windows and Linux.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Empty VALIDATED obligations or newline-dependent evidence hashes.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: release contract, reviewer, guard, and server verifier

proof_requirements.claim: Contract validation, LF/Git-blob parity, full tests, and exact phase-chain replay prove the fix.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: contract validator, git blob hash comparison, tests, production review
proof_requirements.expected_observation: all checks and phase receipts PASS

release_requirements.required_receipt: signed canonical release bundle accepted by server verifier and trusted guard

stop_conditions: Contract invalidity, hash mismatch, test failure, or non-PASS review.
known_discrepancies: CodeRabbit incremental review is rate-limited; exact-head CI and independent review remain mandatory.

requirement_trace.authority: User-authorized correction of every verified review blocker before release
